name: claude-usage-indicator
description: Status bar: context % + 5h + weekly limits for the active Claude chat

claudeUsage.format.markdownDescription: Status bar format. Tokens (wrapped in `%…%`): `%S%`/`%SP%` session context %, `%ST%` session context tokens (e.g. `258k`), `%5h%` 5-hour usage, `%5hr%` 5-hour reset countdown, `%w%` weekly (max bucket), `%wr%` weekly reset countdown, `%wS%` weekly Sonnet, `%wO%` weekly Opus. Unknown tokens are left as-is. Example — tokens only: `%ST%`.
